propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE incorrectly banks met=false for 'budget ran out' cases, misattributing absence-of-evidence as evidence-of-absence and producing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was unreached.

The fix introduces a tri-state evidence outcome (met, refuted, insufficient) carried as framework-set evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false, distinguishing exhaustion from positive refutation while preserving fail-closed semantics for all consumers.
Fallback banking must write only via CriterionBank.record_insufficient() with marker source, not the model-facing tool, so model met=false remains a positive refutation and the tool stays bool-only.

Marker preservation on re-harvest requires overwrite logic: markerless met=false overwrites preserve a prior marker, bare met=false replaces marked entries only on genuine refutation, and met=true clears the marker.

Verdict renderers and close-gate logic must be marker-aware to emit 'insufficient evidence + remediation' for exhaustion cases while remaining fail-closed and distinguishing from unmet-criteria guidance.

The sidecar FAIL payload must include criteria[] and top-level evidence_sufficient marker for durability, requiring audit/page.py consumer to key on verdict string rather than shape to maintain correct FAIL rendering.
